description: Power tool: query any federal geodata layer(s) at a WGS84 point (e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag' for road noise, 'ch.bafu.gefahren-basiskarte' hazards, 'ch.are.bauzonen' building zones). Returns raw attributes per matching feature.

layers.description: Comma-separated geo.admin.ch layer IDs (BOD IDs), e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag'

name: identify_map_layers
title: Identify federal map layers at a point
